heading: NVIDIA: Powering Towards ₹8 Lakh Crore Quarters
tldr: NVIDIA reported Q2 FY27 revenue of $96.2 billion (approximately ₹8 lakh crores), signifying over 100% year-over-year growth.
Data Center revenue continues to be the primary growth engine, reaching $89.0 billion, a 117% increase year-over-year.
The company's gross margins remained strong at 75%, highlighting its pricing power in the AI chip market.
Management provided Q3 FY27 revenue guidance of $108.0 billion, indicating continued acceleration despite concerns about market saturation.
While competition from custom AI chips and other players is increasing, NVIDIA's integrated hardware and software stack maintains its market leadership.
caption:
Ever wondered who makes the "brains" for AI? NVIDIA, the company behind many of these powerful chips, just had an incredible quarter, earning over ₹8 lakh crores! Their data center business is booming as more companies use AI. This shows how fast the world of artificial intelligence is growing. Want to understand what this means for the future?
